title: Shujauddin becomes Nawab
detail: After Murshid Quli Khan’s death, Shujauddin Muhammad Khan assumed the nawabship of Bengal; Sarfaraz Khan was appointed diwan of Bengal.

title: Bihar added to the Bengal subah
detail: Shujauddin added Bihar to the Bengal subah and arranged administration in four divisions: central Bengal, Dhaka, Bihar and Orissa.

title: End of Shujauddin’s reign
detail: Shujauddin died in 1739. Sarfaraz Khan succeeded him as Nawab of Bengal.
